source: 568 Patterns of the “Ancestors”
target: 568 Formae "Proavorum"

source: 568 Patterns of the “Ancestors”
target: 568 Formae "Proavorum"

source: Lumian swiveled his head towards the docks, his body seamlessly blending into the shadows beyond the moonlight’s reach.
target: Lumian caput ad portum convertit, et corpus eius in umbras extra finem lucis lunaris perfecte miscens apparuit.

source: Following the shadowy path, he smoothly bypassed the guards at the entrance, slipping into the sacred-looking building without a sound.
target: Viam umbratam sequens, custodes ad introitum leniter praeteriit, atque in aedificium, quod specio sacra exhibebatur, sine sono se insinuavit.

source: In the foyer, he came to a sudden halt.
target: In atrio subito sistit.

source: Amidst the dark “fishnets,” he spotted short figures with oddly large heads, bulging eyes, and wrinkled skin – like elders in miniature.
target: Inter obscuras “rete piscium”, figuras breves animadvertit, quarum capita insolite magna, oculi protuberantes, et cutis rugosa erant – quasi senes in parva figura.

source: Standing just over a meter tall, they were the “Little Devils” mentioned by Juan Oro, a species of sea spawn.
target: Stantes paulo supra unum metrum, hi “Parvi Diaboli” a Juan Oro commemorati erant, species exordii maritimi.

source: Infiltrating the shadows, these Little Devils patrolled the Governor of the Sea’s residence, using their unique abilities to prevent any unauthorized entry.
target: In umbras insidiantes, hi Parvi Diaboli domicilium Praefecti Maris perscrutabant, singularibus facultatibus utendo ne quis ingressus illicitus fieret.

source: Having encountered them before, Lumian knew these Little Devils weren’t formidable opponents.
target: Cum eos antea obvios habuisset, Lumian scivit hos Parvos Diabolos adversarios formidabiles non esse.

source: Despite their talent for blending into shadows and creating illusions, he could dispatch a team with ease.
target: Quamquam artem in umbras miscendi et illusiones creandi haberent, facile coetum dimittere poterat.

source: Yet, eliminating them discreetly posed a challenge.
target: Attamen eos caute interficere provocationem constituere videbatur.

source: Lumian couldn’t be certain that dealing with one group of Little Devils wouldn’t stir up trouble and alert other creatures lurking in the building.
target: Lumian non certus esse poterat quin tractatio uni coetu Parvorum Diabolorum non tumultum excitaret atque alias creaturas latentis in aedificio adsciret.

source: Focused, Lumian surveyed the areas untouched by shadows.
target: Concentratus, Lumian regiones in quibus umbra non invaserat perlustrare coepit.

source: In the crimson moonlight, he discerned vague figures drifting in the void, intermittently appearing and disappearing.
target: Sub luce rubra lunaris, figuras vagas in vacuo vagantes, interdum apparentes atque evanescentes, deprehendere potuit.

source: These were fish adorned in dark-gray armor, their bulging eyes resembling meatballs at both ends.
target: Hi erant pisces induti armatura obscurae cinerei, quorum oculi protuberantes globulis carnis utrinque similes erant.

source: Starlight-threaded “thin threads” peeked through the gaps in their scale-like armor.
target: Tenues fila, quasi siderum luminibus tincta, per hiatus in armatura squamosa inspici apparuerunt.

source: The peculiar fish hovered in the air, scattering across different regions.
target: Pisces insoliti in aere volitabant, diversas regiones dispergentes.

source: Occasionally, they released bubbles carrying formless storms and impalement-inducing cracks.
target: Interdum bullas emitterunt, quas tempestates informes atque crepitus ad impalationem inducendos portabant.

source: Erupting bubbles created countless invisible spikes, setting perilous traps for teleporting “guests.”
target: Bullae eruptivae innumeros spinas invisibiles creabant, insidias periculosas pro hospitibus “teleportantibus” constituentes.

source: At the hall intersection and various aisles, silent three-man guard teams patrolled.
target: Ad intersectoriam aulae et in variis angulis, turmae tacitarum trium custodum peragrabant.

source: Their expressions betrayed nothing, but Lumian noticed slender black insects, covered in bristles, emerging from their necks and mouths.
target: Vultus eorum nihil patefecerunt, sed Lumian insecta nigra gracilia, setis operta, ex cervicibus atque ore emergere animadvertit.

source: After a brief inspection, the Batings Black Insects swiftly retracted into the guards’ bodies.
target: Post brevem inspectionem, insecta nigra “Batings” celeriter in corpora custodum redierunt.

source: The eyes of sea creature statues on the wall appeared alive, scanning the areas with a strange awareness.
target: Oculi statuarum creaturarum maritimarum in pariete quasi vivos apparuerunt, regiones cum mirabili vigilantia perscrutantes.

source: Just as Juan Oro said, there are a large number of different sea spawn here.
target: Sicut Juan Oro dixit, hic multa genera exordii maritimi sunt.

source: Infiltrating silently amidst the diverse sea spawn here proves to be a formidable task.
target: Silenter inter diversa exordia maritima intrare videbatur negotium formidabile.

source: Lumian, patient, opted to remain in the foyer, awaiting the right moment.
target: Lumian, patienter, decrevit in atrio manere, tempus opportunum exspectans.

source: In under two minutes, a thunderous bang reverberated from the dock.
target: Infra duo minuta, fragor tonitruosus ex portu resonavit.

source: Crimson flames shot into the sky, casting an eerie glow on nearby windows, making them quiver.
target: Flammae rubrae in caelum se proiecerunt, lumen horribilem in fenestris proximis effundentes, quae tremere incitabant.

source: Little Devils lurking in the shadows, Armored Monster Fish manipulating the surrounding void, Batings Black Insects orchestrating guards, and peculiar creatures concealed in the statues’ eyes—all instinctively shifted their focus to the glass window near the dock.
target: Parvi Diaboli latent in umbris, Pisces Monstrorum Armati vacuum circumiectum regentes, insecta nigra “Batings” custodum dispositiones ordinantes, et creaturae insolitae in oculis statuarum absconditae—omnes instinctive ad fenestram vitrei prope portum conspectum converterunt.

source: Lumian sprang into action.
target: Lumian celeriter ad agendum properavit.

source: He orchestrated the disturbance with a delayed explosion!
target: Perturbationem cum explosione dilata ordinavit!

source: Seizing the opportunity, he stealthily navigated through the shadows surrounding the Little Devils and skirted the region patrolled by the Armored Monster Fish.
target: Occasionem capiens, callide per umbras circum Parvos Diabolos peragravit et partem, quam Pisces Monstrorum Armati custodiebant, circumivit.

source: Before other sea spawn could react, he pinpointed the room at the far end of the hall, relying on Juan Oro’s intel.
target: Antequam alia exordia maritima responderent, conclave in extremo aulae locatum statuit, innixus nuntiis Juan Oro.

source: A dim light emitted from the black mark on his right shoulder as he swiftly reached the door of the target room.
target: Lumen pallidum ex signo nigro in umero dextro eius effulsit, cum ad ostium conclavi destinatum celeriter pervenisset.

source: In a blink, he transformed into a shadow, slipping through the crack.
target: In momento, umbram factus est, per fissuram delapsus.

source: Inside, Lumian discovered intricate patterns and symbols etched on the floor, ceiling, and walls, reminiscent of magnified versions of Juan Oro’s hand‑drawn sacrificial ring pattern.
target: Intus, Lumian figuras intricatas et symbola in pavimento, laqueari, et parietibus incisa invenit, quae similia erant ampliata exemplaria schema circuli sacrificii manu delineati a Juan Oro.

source: Besides that, nothing else caught his eye.
target: Praeter id, nihil aliud animadvertum est.

source: Lumian deduced, During the vigil ritual, some sea spawn enter this place, condense the patterns from every direction, and carve them into the ring mold.
target: Lumian coniectavit, durante ritu vigili, aliqua exordia maritima hunc locum intrare, schemata ex omnibus partibus colligere, atque ea in formam annuli incidere.

source: Then, they infuse them with special energy.
target: Deinde ea cum energia speciali infunduntur.

source: Quickly scanning the area, he stepped out of the shadows, activating a black mark on his chest.
target: Celeriter regionem perspexit et ex umbris exiit, in pectore suo signum nigrum activans.

source: Nearly invisible water ripples danced on the surrounding walls, then subsided.
target: Undae aquae paene invisibiles in parietibus circumiectis saltabant, deinde siluerunt.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Ampulla Fictionis!

source: Lumian “enclosed” the two connected rooms into the Bottle of Fiction.
target: Lumian duas cellas conexas in Ampulla Fictionis inclusit.

source: The entry requirement: ordinary humans.
target: Conditio introitus: homines ordinarii.

source: He positioned himself near the opening of the Bottle of Fiction, deliberately creating loud footsteps as he hid by the door.
target: Se posuit prope ianuam Ampullae Fictionis, stridore vestigiis quidem voluntario creante, dum iuxta ostium se celavit.

source: Almost instantly, certain sea spawn picked up on the disturbance.
target: Paene instante, aliqua exordia maritima perturbationem conspexerunt.

source: Recalling the explosion at the docks and the towering flames, they realized they had fallen into a diversion.
target: Reminiscentes explosionem ad portum et flammarum altitudinem, intellexerunt se in diversionem incidisse.

source: Summoning the Armored Monster Fish, Batings Black Insects, Little Devils, and their cohorts, they ordered an investigation into the ring‑making ritual venue for potential infiltrators.
target: Vocantes Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, Insecta Nigra “Batings”, Parvos Diabolos, et eorum comitatus, imperaverunt investigationem in loco ritu annuli faciendi ad deprehendendos insidiatores.

source: Despite attempts to rush in through the door, the sea spawn inexplicably found themselves back in the hall.
target: Quamquam per ostium irrumpere temptabant, exordia maritima inexplicabiliter se in aulam redire invenerunt.

source: The Armored Monster Fish, discerning the issue, released bubbles with a formless storm toward the entrance of the Bottle of Fiction.
target: Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, rem perspicue cognoventes, bullas cum tempestate informi versus introitum Ampullae Fictionis emiserunt.

source: As before they surged towards him, aiming to breach the room, Lumian, now a shadow creature, slipped through the crack at the base of the wooden door, quietly exiting the Bottle of Fiction and returning to the hall.
target: Sicut prius ad eum contendebant, intendentes conclave irrumpere, Lumian, iam creatura umbratica, per fissuram ad radicem ostii lignei delapsus, caute e Ampulla Fictionis exiens in aulam rediit.

source: His ploy successfully diverted the sea spawn’s attention, creating a chance for him to change positions.
target: Consilium eius feliciter attentionem exordii maritimi avertit, sibi occasionem mutandi positionis efficiente praebens.

source: Naturally, he needed to employ effective tactics a few more times!
target: Naturale, necesse erat ut alias artes efficaces nonnullas iteraret!

source: Anticipating the enemy’s disbelief in encountering the same trick repeatedly within a short span, Lumian knew they would assume there were alternative plans.
target: Praevidens hostium incredulitatem, si idem dolus breviter atque plurimas vicibus occursus esset, Lumian scivit eos alia consilia putaturos esse.

source: Of course, on the third attempt, heightened vigilance would set in.
target: Certe, tertia conatu, vigilantia intensior instaurabitur.

source: Everything they saw would seem like a distraction.
target: Omnia, quae vident, quasi decipula videbuntur.

source: When the moment arrived, Lumian could flip the strategy.
target: Cum momentum advenit, Lumian strategiam convertere poterat.

source: Seizing the moment when the sea spawn fixated on the Bottle of Fiction, Lumian deftly avoided the gathering of Little Devils.
target: Occasionem capiens, cum exordia maritima ad Ampullam Fictionis contendere coeperunt, Lumian callide coetum Parvorum Diabolorum evitavit.

source: He circled the Armored Monster Fish, reaching a corner of the hall, and once again utilized Spirit World Traversal.
target: Circumivit Pisces Monstrorum Armatorum, ad angulum aulae perveniens, atque iterum Transitus Mundi Spiritus usus est.

source: This time, Lumian’s destination was the staircase leading to the basement.
target: Hoc tempore, meta Lumiani erat scala quae ad cellam subterranem ducit.

source: The guards, lured into the hall, left the area unmonitored.
target: Custodes, in aulam alliciti, regionem sine vigiliis relinquebant.

source: As Lumian’s silhouette appeared at the staircase entrance, he swiftly transformed into a shadow, slipping into the basement through the darkness.
target: Cum figura Lumiani ad initium scalae apparuit, celeriter in umbram transformatus, per obscuritatem in cellam subterranem se delapsus est.

source: No guards or sea spawn patrolled this seemingly unimportant area, an area that was merely a testament to the villagers of Milo Village’s reverence for their ancestors.
target: Nulli custodes neque exordia maritima in hac apparenter humili regione peragrabant; ipsa regio testabatur reverentiam incolarum vici Milo erga proavos suos.

source: In his shadow creature form, Lumian possessed “natural” night vision.
target: In forma umbratica, Lumian naturali visione nocturna praeditus erat.

source: Even without a fireball, he could vaguely discern the dark basement.
target: Etiam sine pila ignifera, obscuram cellam subterranam vago modo percipere poterat.

source: Despite its dampness due to proximity to the sea, the absence of a moldy odor was thanks to the various Beyonder powers within the building.
target: Quamquam ob propinquitatem maris umida erat, absentia odoris putridi, gratia variis viribus “Beyonder” intra aedificium, constabat.

source: At the center stood a decrepit stone platform, reminiscent of an altar for ancestor worship.
target: In medio stabat suggestum lapideum decrepitus, qui ad aram cultus proavorum reminiscere videbatur.

source: Surrounding it were signs of destruction, leaving only disjointed lines, arcs, and indistinct patterns.
target: Circum illud signa destructionis erant, relinquentes tantum lineas disiunctas, arcus, et schemata indistincta.

source: Do these fragmented symbols and patterns constitute the coat of arms of Milo Village’s ancestors? Or do they possess mystical effects?
target: Num haec symbola fracta et schemata vestimentum armorum proavorum vici Milo efficiunt? An etiam proprietates mysticas habent?

source: Lumian scrutinized them repeatedly, struggling to reconstruct the undamaged version in his mind.
target: Lumian ea iterose perspexit, conans versionem intactam in mente sua recreare.

source: Yet, he sensed that since Noelia of the Fertility Order had alluded to the revealing nature of these symbols and patterns, he might extract valuable information.
target: Attamen sensit, quod ab Noelia Ordinis Fertilitatis, quae ad naturam revelatricem horum symbolorum ac formarum alludebat, pretiosa notitia extrahi posset.

source: What kind of information could it be?
target: Qualis notitia esse posset?

source: Maintaining his shadow creature form, Lumian extended into the darkness, surveying his surroundings.
target: Servans formam umbraticam, Lumian in obscuritatem se extendit, ambitum suum perscrutans.

source: Frowning, he whispered, Could it be that the Church of Earth Mother, fully capable of obliterating this place, deliberately left traces?
target: Frontibus contritis, susurravit: “Num Ecclesia Matris Terrae, quae hunc locum penitus delere posset, conscie vestigia reliquit?”

source: Does this imply that the sea prayer ritual holds some influence over them too?
target: Hocne significat quod ritus orationis maritimae quoque aliquam vim super eos habeat?

source: Lumian directed his gaze at the stone platform, the sacrificial offering to the ancestors, recalling Juan Oro’s details about the ring‑making ritual.
target: Lumian oculos suos ad suggestum lapideum, oblationem sacrificii proavorum, convertit, recolens verba Juan Oro de ritu annuli faciendi.

source: After crafting the Ring of the Sea Queen, it would rest here for an hour as a mark of respect to their ancestors.
target: Postquam annulum Reginae Maris confecerat, hic per horam quiesceret ut signum reverentiae erga proavos.

source: Was it placed on this partially collapsed altar?
target: Num in hoc altero pariter lapsa collocatus est?

source: Approaching the grayish‑black stone platform, Lumian observed no dust accumulation.
target: Accedens ad suggestum lapideum cinereo‑nigro, Lumian nullam pulveris congeries observavit.

source: All remaining lines converged on an empty space at the center of the circle.
target: Omnes lineae residuae in spatium vacuum in centro circuli confluebantur.

source: His heart stirred as he retrieved a Louis d’or, placing it in the center of the altar.
target: Cor eius movebatur, cum Louis d’or recuperavit et in medio altaris posuit.

source: Nothing happened.
target: Nihil accidit.

source: Undeterred, Lumian replaced the Louis d’or with gold risot, Mystery Prying Glasses, Flog boxing gloves, and various other items.
target: Non deterritus, Lumian Louis d’or substituit per aurum risot, specula mirifica “Mystery Prying”, guantiis pugilisticis “Flog” atque variis aliis rebus.

source: Yet, still no anomaly.
target: Attamen, nullus effectus insolitus apparuit.

source: Persistence drove him.
target: Perseverantia eum impulit.

source: Lumian pulled out the silver Lie earring from his pocket and positioned it on an empty space on the stone platform.
target: Lumian argenteum “Lie” aureolum ex sinu extraxit et in spatio vacuo super suggestum lapideum collocavit.

source: In the next moment, a surreal sensation enveloped Lumian.
target: In momento proximo, sensatio insueta Lumian complectit.

source: Within the stone platform, illusory lines and arcs materialized, intertwining with remnants to form two distinct patterns:
target: Intra suggestum lapideum, lineae et arcus illusorii materialiter apparuerunt, et cum reliquis intertexentes duas formas distinctas effingebant:

source: One pattern featured layers of doors sketched with simple strokes, while the other resembled a clock divided into twelve sectors, albeit having a single hand.
target: Una figura continens strata ianuarum, simplicibus lineis delineatarum, exhibebat; altera vero similem erat horologio in duodecim partes divisum, quamquam una sola manum habens.

source: Lumian observed keenly, sensing something adhering to the Lie earring.
target: Lumian acriter observavit, sentiens aliquid ad “Lie” aureolum aderere.

source: In an instant, the lines from the stone platform dimmed, retracted, and returned to their original positions.
target: In momento, lineae e suggesto lapideo obscuratae, retractae, et ad loca initia redierunt.

source: Normalcy resumed.
target: Status normalis rediit.

source: Are these the patterns representing Milo Village’s ancestors? Or did they gain knowledge from the initial revelations?
target: Num hae figurae vestigia proavorum vici Milo efficiunt? An ex primis revelationibus notitiam acceperunt?

source: Lumian sensed sea spawn surging toward the basement.
target: Lumian sentivit exordia maritima in cellam subterranam impetum facere.

source: After muttering to himself, he seized the Lie earring and “teleported” away.
target: Postquam sibi submurmuravit, aureolum “Lie” rapuit et “teleportatus” abiit.

source: In the master bedroom of the suite at Solow Motel.
target: In cella principalis suite apud Solow Motel.

source: As Lumian’s figure manifested, he settled down and began writing to Madam Magician.
target: Cum figura Lumiani apparuit, se stabilivit et ad Dominae Magicae scribere coepit.

source: Unfazed by checking the changes in the Lie earring, he intended to send it to his Major Arcana card holder for inspection.
target: Sine perturbatione mutationes in aureoli “Lie” inspiciens, destinavit id ad tenentem cartae Major Arcana pro recognitione mittere.

source: Recreating the patterns, symbols, structure, and various scenes from the Governor of the Sea’s residence, Lumian neatly folded several letters, arranged a ritual, and summoned the “doll” messenger.
target: Recreando formas, symbola, structuram, et varias scaenas ex domicilio Praefecti Maris, Lumian complures epistulas diligenter plicavit, ritum ordinavit, et “pupam” nuntium evocavit.

source: Then, he patiently awaited the reply.
target: Deinde, patienter responsum exspectavit.
